Bettina, the official handoff date is **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 November says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your own belated cutover recap (8 December 2025) confirms the official handoff was November 3.

For the tracker, you may also want the operational date. Your recap says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 November, and Kwame fully took over on **22 November 2025**. If the tracker needs one date, use 3 November as the official change of hands and note 22 November as when Kwame took full day-to-day ownership.
